title: Little game i made in Mobile Godot
author: HoHOmoshiroi
selftext:
Little game I made with Replit and Claude. At first, I was thinking about making Snake in 3D space, but then it evolved into an endless floating ribbon that collects orbs to maintain its length.

Basically, you gradually get smaller unless you pick up orbs that are the same color as you. Each time you successfully snag an orb, your color changes, which also changes your target.

What do you guys think? I didn’t use any assets, by the way. All code. I don’t know if it’s a good idea tho.

comments.author: norlin
comments.body:
looks awesome and chilling tbh! I would play it on a big screen.

Also from the visuals I wouldn't think it's "vibe coded" lol.

replies.author: HoHOmoshiroi
replies.body: No it's bibe coded. Legit only have one Node3D and a script attached to it. I go back and forth between Claude and Replit to juggle their limit.

comments.author: malingkancut
comments.body: look good but what do u mean in mobile godot? do u make this game entirely on ur phone? how do u do that

replies.author: HoHOmoshiroi
replies.body: Uh, i just told claude to make one node one game in godot. I got to godot, put the node, create the scene, attach the script, and save it. Then i open the main.gd or whatever you wanted to call it in quickedit and paste the code from claude there and save. To clarify again, there's actually a godot app on playstore. I don't know about ios tho.

comments.author: Inkwalker
comments.body: Visually it looks interesting but needs more gameplay. It not obvious that the ribbon gets shorter, there is no pleasure on the player, there is no obvious goals. Even something simple as a score display and a leaderboard would go a long way.

replies.author: HoHOmoshiroi
replies.body: Thank you! Yes, i know there's a lot to be done!
